    • Unsatified withamazon
      5 out of 5 stars
      Great watch for runners and fitness enthusiasts.
      Reviewed in India on 29 April 2026
      Colour: Apex Silver
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      Great watch overall.

      I use this as a fitness device for running and monitoring my heart health and sleep.

      I don't use the phone notifications,messages,calls features although it's there. So don't know how good they work.

      Pros:

      - Very accurate tracking: heart rate, sleep, GPS, resting heart rate (RHR), and heart rate variability (HRV).

      - It even reflected real-life changes—my RHR increased and HRV dropped after a day of drinking, which shows solid reliability.

      - Durable build: despite a few minor accidents, the sapphire glass is still flawless. The bezel has picked up some scratches, though.

      - Offline music works seamlessly—you can download songs and stream directly to Bluetooth earbuds without needing your phone.

      - Excellent for runners:

      - Offline maps and navigation are very useful.

      - Easy transfer process: upload maps to your phone, then to the watch.

      - Comes with 4GB onboard music storage, which is a big plus.

      - Fast charging is convenient.

      Cons:

      - Battery drains quickly during long, continuous GPS usage (e.g., extended runs).

      - Alarms are limited to vibration only—no option to add sound.

      Read moreRead less
